claims.claim: This sewing machine is in a very good condition, just buy and use.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the machine looks intact, but there is no proof of working condition (no operation test, no close-ups of wear, no accessories list).

risks.risk: Whether the machine actually works (motor, speed control, and stitching) and whether it sews properly.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine sewing a straight line on fabric (with needle moving) plus a close-up of the stitch result.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven/untested; treat as needing servicing or not guaranteed to sew well until tested.

risks.risk: Missing or incorrect accessories (bobbin case, bobbins, presser feet, power cable/adapter, manual).
risks.proof: Clear photos of everything included laid out (bobbin case, bobbins, presser feet, power plug, any attachments) and a photo of the bobbin compartment open.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown accessories; assume buyer may need to buy missing parts.

risks.risk: Hidden mechanical wear or damage (timing, belt/gears, feed mechanism, needle bar condition).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the feed dogs, needle area, and bobbin race; plus a video showing smooth feed without skipping.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case for used machines: possible wear requiring maintenance.

risks.proof: Video showing the pedal controlling speed smoothly, and a photo of the power connection/plug.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as electrical function not confirmed.

proof_requests: Send a video of the machine sewing on fabric (straight stitch + reverse if available).
Send close-up photos of the needle area, bobbin compartment, and feed dogs.
List and photograph all accessories included (bobbin case, bobbins, presser feet, power plug/cable, any attachments).
Show the pedal controlling speed in a short clip.
response.reason: From photo 0 the sewing machine appears intact, but there is no remote proof it works or what accessories are included; without that, the correct worst-case pricing cannot be confidently set.
